mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of a near-term recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates weakening demand momentum, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) over two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of earnings deterioration and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 228.0 over one month signals accelerating inflation, which increases the probability of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment signals a labor market breakdown, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances where both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 720,000 units over two months signals strong housing demand, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising residential construction (HOUST) indicates a strong expansionary demand cycle, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.
